name: Dr. Evelyn Reed
title: Professor & Chair of Computer Science
bio: Dr. Reed is a leading researcher in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Her work focuses on developing ethical AI systems and has been published in numerous top-tier journals.

name: Dr. Benjamin Carter
title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
bio: Dr. Carter's research interests lie in cybersecurity and distributed systems. He is passionate about teaching students how to build secure and resilient software.

name: Dr. Olivia Chen
title: Professor of Physics
bio: A theoretical physicist, Dr. Chen's work on quantum entanglement has opened new possibilities for quantum computing. She is a recipient of the prestigious Maxwell Prize.

name: Dr. Marcus Thorne
title: Professor of Business
bio: With 20 years of experience in international business, Dr. Thorne brings a wealth of practical knowledge to his research on sustainable business models and corporate governance.

name: Dr. Sofia Rossi
title: Assistant Professor of Physics
bio: Dr. Rossi is an astrophysicist specializing in exoplanet detection and characterization. She is part of the team that discovered the Kepler-186f exoplanet.
